sections.heading: Treatment for Waukee, from our Johnston campus
body: Waukee has grown fast, and local treatment options have not kept pace. Our Johnston campus is a straight run east along Hickman Road or the I-80 corridor, which puts a full continuum of care — detox through aftercare — inside a manageable drive rather than a relocation.

We see a lot of working parents and commuters from Waukee, which is why our intensive outpatient programme runs morning and evening tracks. You can keep a job and a school pickup schedule and still get 9 to 15 hours of clinical care a week.

sections.heading: Every Level of Care in One Place
sections.subheading: Waukee clients can move between levels without changing providers.

items.title: Medical Detox
items.text: Medically supervised withdrawal with 24/7 clinical monitoring.

items.title: Residential Inpatient
items.text: Full-time inpatient care in a structured, private setting.

items.title: Intensive Outpatient
items.text: Structured therapy on a schedule that fits work or school.

items.title: Dual Diagnosis Treatment
items.text: Integrated care for addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions.

items.title: Aftercare & Alumni
items.text: Alumni support and relapse-prevention planning after treatment.

sections.heading: Getting here from Waukee
body: We are at 5820 Winwood Dr, Johnston, IA 50131 — about 20 minutes from Waukee, with easy access from I-35, I-80 and I-235. Familiar landmarks nearby include Centennial Park, the Raccoon River Valley Trail and Waukee Landing.

sections.heading: Start treatment near Waukee today
body: Admissions specialists are available 24/7. Calls are free, confidential, and carry no obligation to enrol.
